description: TrustAnchor.name_constraints is typed as x509_cert::ext::pkix::constraints::name::NameConstraints, which is now part of the semver contract via the public field. Users constructing TrustAnchor programmatically with NC must import this deeply nested path from x509_cert directly; pkix_path provides no re-export or type alias for it. Any upstream rename or restructuring of that x509_cert path requires a pkix_path semver bump.
title: name_constraints field type not re-exported from pkix_path
